We propose for the first-time transformer-based models for multivariate time-series representation learning, and demonstrate their superiority over existing models for multivariate regression and classification tasks, while at the time offering computational efficiency.

1) we propose the first transformer framework for unsuperved multivariate time series representation learning; 2) we show that pre-trained models outperform fully supervised ones; 3) we show that our models outperform current state of the art methods; 4) we show that the models can be efficiently used in a wide range of downstream tasks.

(1) our proposed transformer-based framework for multivariate time-series representation learning can achieve state-of-the-art accuracy on several benchmark datasets, (2) our proposed framework is computationally more efficient than existing methods, and (3) unsupervised pretraining of transformer models offers a significant performance benefit over supervised learning.
